about: The Rohirrim of the Third Age: tall Men, mostly fair-haired, often with long braids; the men usually bearded; green, gold, brown leather and chain mail.

archer.name: Kaelen the Deeping Archer
archer.prompt: an archer of the Deeping Wall: a human with fair hair in a ponytail and a short beard, leather armor, a short green cloak, and a longbow

citizen.name: Eowyn of Edoras
citizen.prompt: a woman of Edoras: a human woman with long flowing golden hair, a green robe, unarmed

eomer.name: Éomer, Third Marshal of the Riddermark
eomer.prompt: Éomer, Third Marshal of the Riddermark: a tall human warrior with long golden braided hair and a short golden beard, green and silver chain mail, a helmet, a long green cloak, a sword and a green shield

eothain.name: Éothain
eothain.prompt: Éothain, a rider of Éomer's éored: a young tall human with fair braided hair and a short fair beard, chain mail, a helmet with a horse-tail crest, a short green cloak, a spear and a round green shield

eowyn.name: Éowyn, White Lady of Rohan
eowyn.prompt: Éowyn, the White Lady of Rohan: a tall human woman with long flowing golden hair, grey eyes, a white robe, a silver circlet and a long white cloak, unarmed

erkenbrand.name: Erkenbrand
erkenbrand.prompt: Erkenbrand, Lord of the Westfold and master of the Hornburg: an old but strong human lord with long grey braided hair and a grey beard, steel chain mail, a helmet, a long green cloak, a sword and a round shield

farmer.name: Eadric the Farmer
farmer.prompt: a farmer of the Folde: a human man with short fair hair and a short beard, a brown and green tunic, a straw hat, holding a sickle

gamling.name: Gamling
gamling.prompt: Gamling, an old warrior of Rohan: an old human man with grey hair in braids and a long grey beard, leather armor, a short brown cloak, and a sword

gardener.name: Eadric the Gardener
gardener.prompt: a gardener of Rohan: a human man with short fair hair and a short beard, a brown and green tunic, unarmed

gatewarden.name: Eadric the Gatewarden
gatewarden.prompt: a gatewarden of the Hornburg: a broad human with brown hair and a brown beard, chain mail, a helmet, a short brown cloak, a sword and a round wooden shield

grima.name: Gríma Wormtongue
grima.prompt: Gríma Wormtongue, counsellor to the king: a pale, hunched human man with lank black hair and no beard, dark eyes, a black robe with a black hood, unarmed

guard.name: Eadric of the King's Household
guard.prompt: a guard of the King's Household of Rohan: a tall human with long fair braided hair and a short fair beard, gleaming chain mail, a helmet, a long green tabard, a short green cloak, a sword and a green shield

hama.name: Háma
hama.prompt: Háma, doorward of the King: a tall human guard with long fair hair in braids and a fair beard, gleaming chain mail, a helmet, a short green cloak, a sword and a round green shield

herdsman.name: Eadric the Herdsman
herdsman.prompt: a herdsman of Rohan: a lean human with fair braided hair and a short beard, brown leather armor, a short green cloak and a dagger

horse-thegn.name: Ealdred the Stable-Master
horse-thegn.prompt: a horse-thegn of the Hornburg stables: a human with fair braided hair and a short beard, brown leather armor, a short brown cloak, and a dagger

lamplighter.name: Eadric the Fire-Keeper
lamplighter.prompt: a fire-keeper of Edoras: a human man with fair hair in a ponytail and a short beard, a dark brown tunic, carrying a torch

lore.name: Ealdorman Hrothgar
lore.prompt: a lore-keeper of Rohan: an old human man with long white hair and a long white beard, a grey robe and a spellbook

mason.name: Eadric the Timberwright
mason.prompt: a wright of Rohan who works timber: a broad human man with short brown hair and a brown beard, a brown leather tunic and a mace

merchant.name: Eadric the Merchant
merchant.prompt: a trader of Rohan: a human man with brown hair and a short beard, a rich green and gold robe, a short cloak, unarmed

minstrel.name: Ealdred the Minstrel
minstrel.prompt: a minstrel of Rohan: a human man with long golden hair and a short beard, a green tunic and a lute

old-refugee.name: Eadwig of the Westfold
old-refugee.prompt: an old refugee man of the Westfold: an old human man with white hair and a long white beard, a grey robe, unarmed

refugee.name: Elara of the Westfold
refugee.prompt: a refugee woman of the Westfold: a human woman with long fair braided hair, a plain brown robe, unarmed

rider.name: Ealdred of the Mark
rider.prompt: a rider of the Éored of Rohan: a tall human with fair hair in a ponytail and a short beard, chain mail, a helmet, a short green cloak and a longbow

shieldmaiden.name: Eowyn of Rohan
shieldmaiden.prompt: a shieldmaiden of Rohan: a tall human woman with long golden braided hair, leather armor, a short green cloak, a sword and a round green shield

smith.name: Eadric the Iron-Wright
smith.prompt: a smith of Rohan: a broad human with short brown hair and a full brown beard, rust-brown leather armor and a mace

spearman.name: Eored Rider of the Westfold
spearman.prompt: a spearman of the Westfold of Rohan: a tall human with long fair hair and a fair beard, chain mail, a helmet, a short brown cloak, a sword and a round wooden shield

stonemason.name: Thorgard the Mason
stonemason.prompt: a stonemason of the Westfold mending the walls: a broad human man with short grey hair and a grey beard, a dusty grey tunic and a mace

theoden.name: Théoden, King of Rohan
theoden.prompt: Théoden, King of Rohan: an old but proud human king with long white hair and a long white beard, a golden crown, gold-trimmed green and white chain mail, a long green cloak, and a sword

watchman.name: Eadric the Watchman
watchman.prompt: a watchman of the Hornburg: a human man with fair hair in a ponytail and a short beard, a dark brown tunic, carrying a torch

water.name: Elswyth of the Mark
water.prompt: a water-carrier of Rohan: a human woman with long fair braided hair, a plain blue tunic, unarmed

yeoman.name: Folde Yeoman
yeoman.prompt: a yeoman of the Folde in Rohan: a sturdy human farmer with fair hair and a short beard, a padded brown jerkin, a short green cloak and a spear
